text: Inventor Randall Peltzer [brings his son Billy a furry little mogwai from a Chinatown shop|trigger|bringing something home] for Christmas, with three rules: no bright light, no water, and never feed it after midnight. In the town of Kingston Falls, spilled water spawns more of them, led by the mischievous Stripe, who [tricks Billy into feeding them late|rules|break the rule and pay]. They cocoon and hatch as [reptilian gremlins|threat|monsters and creatures], and by Christmas Eve an army of them is loose from a YMCA swimming pool.
